description: Estimate the credit cost of a verification before running it, and whether the user can afford it. Provide either a count of emails, a list_id to re-verify, or an operation ('single'/'finder'). Always quote this before proposing anything billable.

emails.description: Number of emails to verify (1 credit each).

list_id.description: Estimate re-verifying an existing list by its id.

operation.description: Operation type: bulk/single (1 credit) or finder (3 credits).

name: estimate_cost
